excerpt: Forged out of the Washington, DC punk/indie scene, Dead Meadow formed in 1998 and have since moved to the Los Angeles area. They have released ten albums thus far including their 2023 release titled Force Free Form. The band is clearly informed by ‘60s psychedelic rock, creating layered soundscapes filled with trippy jams and chilled out atmospheres.
